data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'farh' meaning 'breeze' or 'wind'. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that Farhah represents the gentle and soothing effects of the wind, symbolizing peace, tranquility, and freshness. It is also mentioned in the Quran as one of the names of the Prophet Solomon's horse. The name Farhah carries the meaning “Gentle Breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farhah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
